title: Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Rate Card: Term Length, Free Months, Discount and Locked Rent
content:
The Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan is sold in six terms. Each plan covers a fixed number of billing periods of one rental agreement, some of which may be free months that are not charged, and gives a discount on the rent of the charged months. Every plan locks the monthly rent for the whole term.

## Term and discount by plan

| Plan | Billing periods covered | Free months within the term | Discount on the charged months' rent | Charged months (periods covered less free months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | 3 | 0 | 3% | 3 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | 6 | 0 | 5% | 6 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | 9 | 0 | 6% | 9 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | 12 | 1 | 5% | 11 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | 18 | 1 | 7% | 17 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | 24 | 2 | 7% | 22 |

The free months are billing periods inside the term, not periods added after it: a 12-month plan covers 12 billing periods, of which 1 is free.

## Locked rent and term start

| Plan | Rent locked during the term | Which rent is locked | Day the term starts | Lowest monthly rent the plan may lock |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $60.00 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | Yes | The rent in effect on the term start date | The covered agreement's next due date | $60.00 |

"Rent locked during the term: Yes" means the monthly rent of the covered agreement cannot change while the term runs.

## Reading the card

- **Minimum locked rent, both sides (hypothetical rents).** A monthly rent of exactly $25.00 meets the floor of the 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month plans; $24.99 does not. A monthly rent of $60.00 meets the floor of the 18- and 24-month plans; $59.99 does not, although it meets the $25.00 floor of the shorter plans.
- **Which periods are free.** The 3-, 6- and 9-month plans have no free month; every period they cover is a charged month at the discounted rent. The 12- and 18-month plans have one free month and the 24-month plan has two.
- **Highest discount.** The 18- and 24-month plans carry the highest discount on the card, 7%; the 12-month plan's discount (5%) is lower than the 9-month plan's (6%), while the 12-month plan alone of those two has a free month.
